name: Вестник Разлома
subject: A floating dark-plum crystal-and-armor entity: broad squared upper torso, pale angular cubic mask, bright magenta stepped suspended CRYSTAL core at chest. Instead of legs, tapering layered large voxel shards form a pointed lower body hovering with no ground. Broken pale lavender HALO attached behind head, two tall side pieces and incomplete top piece, no perfect golden circle. TWO separate chunky rune-less stone/crystal PILLARS orbit at body sides at fixed height, one left and one right, each inset magenta square seal; their placement stays identical in all views and may overlap naturally in profiles. Broad block forearms with simple stone hand tips; no held weapon, cape, horns or human feet. Discrete large voxel facets, not fine crystal gravel, pink emissive core without environmental light/shadows or smoke cloud.
caption: Пять ракурсов босса в крупной воксельной стилистике; развитие существующего силуэта и палитры.
